messages:
maya: FYI planning a kernel ABI + quant build swap Thu 22:00 UTC. target: kernel v4.12 + quant-v3.
maya: need ops window, pinlist, and rollback safety before we trigger the deploy-bot. canary plan below.
ezra: 22:00 UTC works for me. we should reserve a 60m change window.
lucas: QA can run smoke suite starting 21:15 UTC in staging, will post results to this thread.
maya: Deploy plan: canary 2% (15m), ramp 20% (30m), ramp 100% (gradual, 1h). hold after each stage.
maya: Rollback criteria: error-rate >0.8% sustained 3min, p95 latency +40%, or matching failing evals from regression set.
sre-oncall: add CPU OOM and KV cache evict alerts to the canary dashboard, and set auto-snooze to 2m.
anya: For customers with dedicated pools, we should pin them to kernel v4.11 automatically. list:
```sh
# pin command
redwoodctl pin --pool dedicated-cust-42 --kernel v4.11
redwoodctl pin --pool dedicated-cust-88 --kernel v4.11
```
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created by @maya: rollout/2149876543
deploy-bot: Stages: canary(2%)@2149876543 -> ramp(20%) -> full(100%). Change window: 60m.
maya: Release notes draft: /docs/releases/runtime-2026-03-14.md - add KB about quant-v3 expected token drift and patch build id.
ezra: QA will link failing test ids. if anything flakes, we pin back and open hotfix.
lucas: Smoke run: staging passed all perf checks. delta p95 = +8% (acceptable).
anya: I've queued the pin ops for dedicated pools, will run 21:50 UTC.
maya: Can someone run a quick canary checklist before trigger? items: health endpoints, kv-cache pressure, model fidelity checks, rollout throttles.
sre-oncall: Checklist acked. I will watch infra for the first 30m and take manual rollback if alerts fire.
maya: Ok triggering preflight now.
maya: preflight output:
```
preflight: ok
kv_cache: healthy
binary_sig: match
quant_build: v3 - checksum abc123
```
deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed. Ready to start canary when @maya triggers.
maya: Triggering canary now. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary started: 2% traffic -> kernel v4.12, quant-v3.
lucas: Observability: p50/p95 stable so far. no errors.
20m later - maya: canary looks ok, moving to ramp 20%.
deploy-bot: Ramped to 20%.
anya: Dedicated pins applied.
sre-oncall: No infra alerts. latency stable.
1h later - maya: full ramping now per plan.
deploy-bot: Ramped to 100%.
maya: Post-deploy notes: small p95 increase on long-tail queries, observed +12% only. monitoring set to 48h.
maya: I'll update release notes and prod changelog.
ezra: Thanks team. If any regressions show up we'll rollback and patch.
maya: closing thread, moving changelog to final.
